findings: THE NONDETECTIONS AS A RULING-OUT. 'Status: Extensive tracking by NASA, ESA (including the JUICE mission), Webb, Hubble, and radio arrays confirmed it is a natural comet, ruling out artificial or technological origin hypotheses.' The radio arrays' contribution is the published technosignature searches, each a nondetection within the frequencies, drift rates and power limits it states; the notebook (#1742 §9.3) on what such a null constrains, after #1450. 'Confirmed it is a natural comet' rests on the spectroscopy; 'ruling out artificial or technological origin hypotheses' adds an exclusion no search claims.

THE DEBATE ERASED WITH ITS PRINCIPAL. The composition has no anomaly, no dispute and no name from the debate the object drew: Avi Loeb and his scale (Level 4, held from July 2025, arXiv:2508.09167) are absent from body and cards (the paste carries no 'Loeb'). The address that seats his position is 'avi loeb 3i atlas' (avi-loeb-3i-atlas-aio-20261102), where the Overview composed his July view as a December concession.

AN AGE CREDITED TO THE COMA'S TELESCOPES. 'indicate 3I/ATLAS may be 10 to 12 billion years old', attributed to 'Studies by telescopes including the James Webb Space Telescope'. The age comes from the object's velocity, by a kinematic method (Hopkins et al.; the Royal Astronomical Society's release gives a 68 per cent interval of 7.6–14 billion years; checked for 3i-atlas-signal-studies-aio-20261104). The composition joins it to the telescopes that measured composition.

A SPEED RANGE THAT MIXES TWO QUANTITIES. 'at speeds exceeding 221,000 to 246,000 km/h (approx. 68.3 km/s)'. 68.3 km/s is 245,880 km/h; 221,000 km/h is 61.4 km/s. The range runs from one speed to another without saying which is which (the speed at infinity and the speed near perihelion are different quantities).

WHAT IS ACCURATE. The designation, the discovery and the identifiers (the Wikipedia card: 'Identifiers: 3I/ATLAS, C/2025 N1, A11pl3Z.'), and the activity: an icy, outgassing comet with a CO₂-rich coma.

SMALLEST REPAIR. 'Spectroscopy establishes cometary activity; radio technosignature searches found no signal within their stated bands, drift rates and power limits; Avi Loeb ranked the object at Level 4 on his scale, below the line where artificial origin is suspected.' COUNTERTEST: rerun 'avi loeb 3i atlas' and record whether the scale or the level appears.
